title: The Wasserstein--Ebin Metric: A Geometric Lift of Unbalanced Optimal Transport to the space of Riemannian metrics
summary: We introduce dynamic and static formulations that formally extend unbalanced optimal transport from the space of positive densities to the space of Riemannian metrics. The first construction is based on a dynamic variational formulation in which the evolution of a Riemannian metric is driven by transport together with a source term. Choosing the $L^2$-metric to penalize the transport vector field and the Ebin metric to penalize the source component yields a new Riemannian metric on the manifold of Riemannian metrics, which we call the Wasserstein--Ebin metric.
